tools.falsifier: REFUTED IF the plan_run reaches status='validated' during the turn — that is the defect, unchanged. PASSES IF the run is still 'proposed' afterwards AND the persisted validation_report says passed=true: the verdict was reached and recorded, and it did not authorise anything. 🔴 A RUN WHOSE REPORT SAYS passed=false MUST BE READ AS NEITHER — the old code only ever stamped on a pass, so a failing lint exercises a branch that was never the defect and counting it as a pass would be scoring the wrong thing.

answer_expect.why: None. The measurement is the plan_run's status and the validation_report artifact in loreweave_composition, read after the turn — not the reply text.

ship_audit.gate: N/A — Tier R, and the whole point of the fix is that it stays a read.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a book with no plan run must be refused, not silently validated.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — validating twice must not change the run either time.
ship_audit.tenancy: Throwaway fixture book per repeat, torn down by the harness.
